items.title: Mrs. Francis Oliver Interview, 1969-05-10
items.q: Some of the things with Barney Bighard on. ... But every time I hear the records, I cry

ctx.x: One is named Shadows, and the other one is named something else.
Some of the things with Barney Bighard on.
Yeah. We'll just see if I haven't got one of them on here. But every time I hear the records, I cry, so I don't put them on there very often.
